snippet.title: Protect a President You Don’t Know | Social Deduction Game Demo
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4336960/Save_the_President__Trust_Issues/

Protect a President you don’t know.

One player is secretly the killer hiding among you.
The Agent observes player interactions to uncover the truth.

Work together to repair systems, investigate suspicious behavior, and accuse carefully.

One wrong accusation ends the game.

Demo is now available on Steam.
